en-GB.name: Dino Books
en-GB.summary: Free picture-book stories, read aloud for children.
en-GB.description: Dino Books reads free children's stories aloud. Say a book's name, or say search, and listen. You can pause, carry on, skip to the next story or start again. There is nothing to sign in to and nothing to buy.
examplePhrases: Alexa, ask Dino Books to read Goldilocks
Alexa, ask Dino Books to play the little red hen

publishingInformation.testingInstructions: No account linking, no sign-in and no purchases. Say 'Alexa, open Dino Books' to be offered a book, then say 'yes' to hear it or 'search' to hear the list of books and say one of them. Pause, resume, next, previous, start over and stop all work with the standard Alexa commands. The books come from the live store list, so a book appears here only once its listening track is published.
